name: VaultConnection
description: VaultConnection is one saved login, for the tool or Git host at its address.

fields.name: Token
fields.description: The access token. Never returned: every read shows it empty.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: How the login was saved. Set by the server.

fields.name: SignIn
fields.description:
The sign-in that produced the token, when it came from one. Set by the
 server.

fields.name: SavedBy
fields.description: Who saved the current token, by identity account id. Set by the server.

fields.name: SavedAt
fields.description: When the current token was saved. Set by the server.
